subject: english
question: The main theme of the passage is

options.text: Vegetation and animal life in Savanna
Wealth of animal life in Africa

solution:
The correct answer is option 3), i.e., 'Vegetation and animal life in Savanna.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The central theme of the passage talks about the characteristics of the savanna landscape. It consists of tall grasses like elephant grass, mallee, mulga, spinifex grass and shrubs. Trees like acacias, baobabs, and bottle trees are found here due to their drought-resistant properties. Also, the passage mentions herbivorous animals like zebra, antelope, giraffe, deer, gazelle, elephant, and okapi are found here. Carnivorous animals of the savanna are lion, tiger, leopard, hyena, panther, jaguar, jackal, Iynx and puina.
 
• Therefore we can conclude the theme of the passage is 'Vegetation and animal life in Savanna.'
 
• Hence, the only possible answer is option 3.
